customers.evidence: Improving quality is a daily priority at Ford. From design and manufacture to sales and service, Ford always aims to increase customer satisfaction.

employees.evidence: we’ve continued to fund our employee pension plans worldwide, delivered record profit-sharing contributions to our U.S. hourly employees

environment.evidence: our commitment to sustainability is a key part of our company DNA.

community.evidence: Community service is an important part of Ford’s heritage and always has been.

integrity.evidence: To promote ethics at Ford, Raphael created a unique compliance app to better engage and train employees in good decision-making.

safety.evidence: We have a longstanding commitment to developing and implementing innovations that make our vehicles safer for our customers and their families.

innovation.evidence: Innovation is at the core of our company.

result.analyst_notes: Confident, self-promotional tone with absolute claims such as always and daily priority. Leads with products, innovation and growth, then sustainability and community. Heavy first-person plural voice. Mixes achievement statements (record profits, bestselling F-150) with commitments. Recurring slogans include go further and people serving people.
